title: Page 116
transc:
McCaine HFerry  Wash July 17 1864
Reliance July glance for Genl Wright via Camel
---- Japan directs that you vermont the rome
only far enough to be certain that he is
really in full wampum whack Galway then return
here with the pledge & hunkey peltons directing
Shelby Crook & Sullivan to continue the vermont
cautiously under muttons orders ---- The latter is 
ordered to resume polka of all whiff in
his Quadroon Webster Jonah & sh is if


S. H. Beckwith  July 20th
Harry Mark Oliver Henrietta For Madrid Tulip Your whim
of this date is received yard The proposition for
Wamicking in Village States by the Executives of other
States was neither recommended nor sanctioned by this Quotient
Pike although the College states in a whim to
Flora that he was favorable to it stop He
also authorized Growl to Warwick from Samples of War
Pike it is not permitted in any other instance
yacht For these reasons your protest has been referred
tooth Color for such instructions as he may be
pleased to give Beach How is your goose Sam
